d: Short, messy platinum white hair with choppy bangs and two small pigtails at the nape of the neck. Large, wide-eyed expression with pale lime green irises. An adolescent appearance with a slender, petite build. Wearing a complex sci-fi tactical suit in a palette of navy blue, white, and bright orange, featuring a heavy black chest rig with various pouches and a thick black utility belt. Accessories include a black tactical headset around the neck and a pair of amber-tinted goggles with a black frame resting on the forehead.
